name: Spam Fortress II
author: AAidalol
description: A level made back in August 2025, intended to be like the dash orb spam at the end of UwU Challenge and Unemployment Circles, but for a full level. Inconsistent, and a chokeable second to last click. Aida hates this level and wishes she never made it. Also forgotten for a while, before getting re-placed in July 2026.
